question: A triangular window has dimensions such that its area is 45% of a square window of area 200 m². If its base is 10 m, find its height.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of triangle = 45% of 200 = 90 m².

Height = (2 × Area) ÷ Base

⇒ h = (2 × 90) ÷ 10

⇒ h = 180 ÷ 10 = 18 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of square window = 200 m²

Base of triangular window (b) = 10 m

Area of triangle = 45% of square window's area

**Formula Used:**

Area of triangle = ½ × base × height

 
 Square Area = 200 m² 
• 45% 
 Area = 90 m²

 h = ?

• Base = 10 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of triangular window = (45 ÷ 100) × 200

⇒ Area = 90 m²

Substituting the values in the formula:

⇒ ½ × 10 × h = 90

⇒ 5 × h = 90

⇒ h = 90 ÷ 5

⇒ h = 18 m

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × side². In an equilateral triangle, all sides and internal angles are equal.

Area of Square

Area = side². Alternatively, it can be computed using the diagonal as Area = ½ × diagonal².

Right-Angled Triangle

Area = ½ × base × perpendicular. It strictly follows Pythagoras Theorem: hypotenuse² = base² + perpendicular².
